Rashi on Pesachim 97a:10:1.hebrew: אלא רועה לרבי - באבודין, היכי משכחת לה דתיקום "כל שבחטאת רועה" דשמואל:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:10:1.english: But [a sin-offering that is left to] graze, according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] - In [the case of] lost [sin-offerings], how do you find it, so that Shmuel's [rule of] "any sin-offering [that is left to] graze" can be established?

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:1:1.english: One might [have thought] even before the Paschal lamb [it is] so - [That] the substitute of a Paschal lamb that was found before the (second) Paschal lamb should be sacrificed as a peace-offering.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:1:2.hebrew: תלמוד לומר הוא - פסח הוא: הפסח כשר קרב, ואין תמורתו קריבה. לאו תמורת ההוא דקרב קא ממעט, אלא הכי קאמר: יש תמורת פסח שאינה קריבה:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:1:2.english: The verse states: "It" - "It is a Passover offering" — the valid Paschal lamb is sacrificed, and its substitute is not sacrificed. It is not excluding the substitute of that [lamb] which is sacrificed; rather, this is what it means: there is a substitute of a Paschal lamb that is not sacrificed.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:2:1.hebrew: פשיטא - דלא קרבה, דהא הוקבעה ונדחה בפסח. ואע"ג דלעיל אמר מתני' הא קא משמע לן דאיכא תמורת פסח דלא קרבה, קרא מיהא לא איצטריך לאשמעינן הכי:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:2:1.english: Obvious - That it is not offered, for it was established and rejected as a Pesach [offering]. And even though above [the Gemara] said [that] the Mishnah teaches us this — that there is a substitute of a Pesach [offering] that is not offered — a verse, however, is not needed to teach us this.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:2:2.hebrew: ה"ג: אמר שמואל כל שבחטאת מתה כו', ור' יוחנן אמר אין הפסח קרב שלמים אלא שנמצא אחר שחיטה, אבל קודם שחיטה לא - כל שבחטאת מתה: חמש חטאות מתות, הלכה למשה מסיני, כונסן לכיפה והן מתות: ולד חטאת, ותמורת חטאת, וחטאת שמתו בעליה, וחטאת שנתכפרו בעליה על ידי האחרת — שאבדה זאת ואחר כך נמצאת — ושעברה שנתה. ונקט שמואל גבי פסח סימנא ביה, ואמר כל שבחטאת מתה — אי מיתרע הכי בפסח — קרב שלמים. וקא סלקא דעתך דאכולהו מתות דחטאת דאשתכחן גבי פסח, קרב שלמים; דהיינו תמורת פסח, ופסח שמתו בעליו, ושכיפרו בעליו, ושעברה שנתו, קריבין שלמים:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:2:2.english: This is how we read [the text]: Shmuel said: Whatever in [the case of] a sin-offering is left to die, etc. And Rabbi Yochanan said: The Passover-offering is not offered as a peace-offering unless it was found after the slaughter, but before the slaughter, no - "Whatever in [the case of] a sin-offering is left to die": Five sin-offerings are left to die — [a] law [given] to Moses at Sinai; one brings them into a cell and they die: the offspring of a sin-offering, and the substitute of a sin-offering, and a sin-offering whose owner died, and a sin-offering whose owner achieved atonement through another [animal] — where this one was lost and afterward found — and [a sin-offering] whose [first] year has passed. And Shmuel used a mnemonic for it regarding the Passover-offering, and said: "Whatever in [the case of] a sin-offering is left to die" — if it happens thus with a Passover-offering — "it is offered as a peace-offering." And you would initially assume that for all [cases of] sin-offerings left to die that are found regarding a Passover-offering, it is offered as a peace-offering — that is, the substitute of a Passover-offering, and a Passover-offering whose owner died, and [one] whose owner achieved atonement [through another], and [one] whose [first] year has passed are offered as peace-offerings.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:3:1.hebrew: וכל שבחטאת רועה - לקמן מפרש מאי היא. ומיתה ורעיה לאו קולא וחומרא איכא בחדא מאידך, והאי דנקט גבי מיתה דחטאת בפסח קרב, וגבי רעיה דחטאת בפסח רעיה, לאו טעמא קא יהיב ביה דמשום דהכא מתה הכא קרב, אלא סימנא בעלמא הוא:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:3:1.english: And any [case] where a sin-offering is left to graze - Later [the Gemara] explains what this is. And [between] death and grazing, there is no leniency or stringency in one over the other; and that which [Shmuel] stated regarding the death of a sin-offering [that] with a Paschal lamb it is sacrificed, and regarding the grazing of a sin-offering [that] with a Paschal lamb [it is left to] graze, he is not giving a reason for it — that because here it dies, here it is sacrificed — rather, it is merely a mnemonic.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:4:1.hebrew: וכללא הוא - דכל שבחטאת רועה, בפסח רועה:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:4:1.english: Is that a general rule - that whatever grazes in [the case of] a sin-offering grazes in [the case of] a Passover offering?

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:4:2.hebrew: דריש לקיש - במס' תמורה, בפרק ולד חטאת (תמורה דף כב.). והתם מותיב לה ממתניתין דהתם, דקתני: ושעברה שנתה כו'. ומתרץ לה, דהכי קתני: שעברה שנתה ואבדה [או אבדה] ונמצאת בעלת מום:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:4:2.english: Of Reish Lakish - [This statement is found] in Tractate Temurah, in the chapter [entitled] Velad Chatat (Temurah 22a). And there, [the Gemara] raises an objection against it from the Mishnah there, which teaches: "And [a sin-offering] whose year has passed, etc." And [the Gemara] resolves it, [explaining] that this is what [the Mishnah] is teaching: "[One] whose year has passed and was lost [or: was lost] and was found [to be] blemished."

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:4:3.hebrew: כאילו עומדת בבית הקברות - כל מקום שהיא, רואין כאילו היא בבית הקברות, שאין כהן נכנס שם לשוחטה; ורועה עד שתסתאב ותימכר, ויפלו דמיה נדבה לשופרות שכתוב עליהן "נדבה", ומקייצים בה את המזבח. זה מדרשו של יהוידע הכהן במסכת תמורה (דף כג:), שכל מותר חטאת ואשם לקיץ המזבח, חוץ מחטאות מתות, שהן הלכה למשה מסיני:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:4:3.english: As though it were standing in a cemetery - Wherever it is, we view [it] as though it were in a cemetery, where a priest cannot enter to slaughter it; and it grazes until it becomes blemished and is sold, and its proceeds fall [as] a freewill-offering into the horn-shaped chests upon which "Freewill-offering" is written, and with it they provide the altar's "dessert" [surplus burnt-offerings]. This is the exposition of Yehoiada the Priest in Tractate Temurah (23b), that every surplus of a sin-offering or guilt-offering goes to the altar's "dessert," except for sin-offerings that must be left to die, which are a law [given] to Moses from Sinai.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:5:1.hebrew: כשב לרבו' כו' - קתני מיהת פסח שעברה שנתו קרב:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:5:1.english: "A lamb," to include, etc. - At any rate, it teaches [that] a Paschal lamb whose year has passed is sacrificed [as a peace-offering].

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:5:2.hebrew: ה"ג כי קאמר שמואל באבודין בדחויין לא אמר ובאבודין מי משכחת לה כו' - כי אמר שמואל כל שבחטאת מתה, לאו אכולהו קאי, אלא אכיפרו בעליה לחודא שהיא על ידי איבוד. ואמתו בעליה לא קאי, דלא משכחת ביה רועה, אלא אכיפרו בעליה לחוד קא משכחת ליה לרועה, כדלקמן. וגבי פסח נמי אכיפרו בעליו קאי, וכללא הוא דכל פסח שכיפרו בעליו באחר — רועה אם כיוצא בו בחטאת רועה, וקרב שלמים אם כיוצא בו בחטאת מתה. אבל אם חטאת דחויה, כגון עברה שנתה, שעומדת בפנינו והרי היא דחויה מהקריב — לא אמר:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:5:2.english: This is the reading: When Shmuel stated [his principle, it was] with regard to lost [offerings]; with regard to deferred [offerings] he did not state [it]. And with regard to lost [offerings], do you find [it], etc. - When Shmuel stated, "Any [case] where a sin-offering dies," he was not referring to all of them, rather only to [the case where] its owners gained atonement [through another offering], which comes about through loss. And he was not referring to [the case where] its owners died, since you do not find [a case of] grazing in it; rather, only with regard to [the case where] its owners gained atonement do you find [a case of] grazing, as [will be explained] below. And regarding a Paschal lamb as well, it refers to [a case where] its owners gained atonement, and it is a general rule that any Paschal lamb whose owners gained atonement through another [animal] — it grazes if the corresponding case in a sin-offering grazes, and it is sacrificed as a peace-offering if the corresponding case in a sin-offering dies. However, if [it is] a deferred sin-offering — such as [one whose] year has passed, which stands before us and is deferred from being sacrificed — he did not state [this rule].

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:7:1.hebrew: והרי אבודה בשעת הפרשה - חטאת שאבדה עד שהפריש אחרת תחתיה, ונמצאת קודם הקרבת השניה — לרבנן דפליגי עליה דרבי במס' תמורה (דף כב:) ואמרי דלרעיה אזלא, דתנן: המפריש חטאת כו':
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:7:1.english: But [what about] one lost at the time of separation - [I.e.,] a sin-offering that was lost until he separated another in its place, and it was found before the sacrificing of the second [offering] — according to the Rabbis, who disagree with Rabbi in Tractate Temurah (22b) and say that it goes to graze, as we learned [in the Mishnah]: "If one separated a sin-offering," etc.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:7:2.hebrew: אין חטאת מתה - משום כיפרו בעליה, אלא האבודה בשעת כפרה ונמצאת אחר שנתכפרו הבעלים. הא נמצאת קודם כפרה, כיון דאמרי רבנן לא מתה, הויא לה מותר חטאת ורועה, ודמיה לשופרות:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:7:2.english: A sin-offering does not die - on account of "its owners received atonement," except [for] one that was lost at the time of atonement and was found after the owners received atonement. However, [if] it was found before atonement, since the Rabbis say it does not die, it becomes a surplus sin-offering and grazes, and its proceeds [go] to the [Temple] chests.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:8:1.hebrew: ואילו בפסח - כי האי גוונא, אבד בשעת הפרשה ונמצא קודם שחיטה אחר חצות:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:8:1.english: And yet with regard to the Paschal lamb - In such a case, [where] it was lost at the time of separation and found before slaughter, after midday.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:8:2.hebrew: קרב שלמים - כר' זירא, דאמר קודם חצות ואחר חצות שנינו. אלמא פסח שהיה לפנינו בשעת כפרה, ובלבד שיהא אבוד בחצות, קרב שלמים:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:8:2.english: It is sacrificed as a peace-offering - Like Rabbi Zeira, who said [that] we learned [the Mishnah as referring to] before midday and after midday. Thus, a Paschal lamb that was before us at the time of atonement — provided that it was lost at midday — is sacrificed as a peace-offering.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:8:3.hebrew: שמואל כר' סבירא ליה - ורועה בחטאת דקאמר שמואל, לקמיה מפרש. והוא הדין דמצי לתרוצי: שמואל כרבה סבירא ליה, דאמר קודם שחיטה שנינו, ובפסח נמי אבוד בשעת הפרשה רועה; ולקמן מפרש לה בלישנא אחרינא הכי:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:8:3.english: Shmuel holds in accordance with Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] - And [as for] "left to pasture" regarding a sin-offering that Shmuel stated, [the Gemara] explains [it] shortly. And similarly, [the Gemara] could have answered [that] Shmuel holds in accordance with Rabbah, who said we learned "before the slaughter," and regarding a Paschal lamb as well, [one that was] lost at the time of designation is left to pasture; and later [the Gemara] explains it in another version thus:

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:9:1.hebrew: נמצא קודם חצות - אפילו לר' זירא רועה, דקבעתיה חצות:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:9:1.english: Found before midday - Even according to Rabbi Zeira it grazes, since [it is] midday [that] establishes it.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:9:2.english: Before midday - For it is a time that is not fit for it to be offered.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:9:3.hebrew: לאו אבוד הוא - ואפילו הפריש אחר תחתיו קודם שנמצא, לאו (מיתה) אבוד חשיב ליה:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:9:3.english: It is not [considered] lost - And even if he separated another [animal] in its place before it was found, it is not considered lost.

Rashi on Pesachim 97a:9:4.hebrew: דאמר רבא - גבי חטאת, אבידת לילה, והפריש אחרת תחתיה בלילה ונמצאת (תחתיה) לאור הבוקר — אפילו לרבי לאו למיתה אזלא אלא לרעיה, הואיל ולילה לאו שעת הקרבה היא:
Rashi on Pesachim 97a:9:4.english: As Rava said - With regard to a sin-offering, [if it was] lost at night, and he set aside another in its stead at night, and [the original] was found by the light of morning — even according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], it does not go to death, but rather to grazing, since night is not the time of offering.

Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:10:1.hebrew: אלא רועה לרבי היכי משכחת לה - דליכא למימר כגון שנאבדה בלילה, דאבידת לילה לאו שמה אבידה, ושמואל באבודין איירי כדפרישית:
Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:10:1.english: "But according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], under what circumstances can [a sin-offering that is left to] graze be found?" - For one cannot say [that it refers to] a case such as where it was lost at night, because being lost at night is not considered "lost," and Shmuel is speaking of lost [sin-offerings], as I explained [earlier].

Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:2:1.hebrew: אילימא שנמצא קודם שחיטה והמיר בו קודם שחיטה פשיטא למה לי קרא - ואע"ג דקתני ליה במתני' לאשמעינן דאיכא תמורה דלא קרבה, מ"מ לא איצטריך להכי:
Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:2:1.english: If we say that it was found before the slaughter and one performed the substitution before the slaughter, it is obvious; why do I [need] a verse - Even though it is taught in the Mishnah to teach us that there is a temurah that is not offered, nevertheless [a verse] is not needed for this.

Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:2:2.hebrew: פשיטא - השתא לא שייך לשנויי דקרא אסמכתא בעלמא כדשני לעיל, דאם כן קרא למאי אתא:
Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:2:2.english: It is obvious - Now it is not applicable to answer that the verse is merely an asmakhta [a scriptural support], as [the Gemara] answered above, for if so, what does the verse come [to teach]?

Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:2:3.hebrew: אלא לאו שנמצא קודם שחיטה - תימה: ללישנא קמא, מאי מקשה אביי לרבה מהך ברייתא? והלא סיפא מסייעתא לו בהדיא כדמסיק השתא! וזהו תימה לומר שלא ידע אביי סיפא דברייתא דמקשי מינה:
Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:2:3.english: Rather, is it not [a case] where it was found before the slaughter - This is astonishing: according to the first version, what difficulty does Abaye raise against Rabbah from this baraita? Does not the latter clause [of the baraita] explicitly support him, as [the Gemara] concludes now! And it is astonishing to say that Abaye did not know the latter clause of the baraita from which he was raising a difficulty.

Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:3:1.hebrew: אמר שמואל כל שבחטאת מתה כו' - שמואל כרבי זירא סבר דאמר חצות קבע, מדא"ר יוחנן: "אין הפסח קרב שלמים אלא שנמצא אחר שחיטה", והכי [דייק] לקמן:
Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:3:1.english: Shmuel stated: Any [animal] that in [the case of] a sin-offering [is left to] die, etc. - Shmuel holds like Rabbi Zeira, who says that midday establishes [the offering's status], [as is evident] from [the fact] that Rabbi Yochanan said: "A Paschal lamb is sacrificed as a peace-offering only when it was found after the slaughter," and so [the Gemara] infers below:

Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:4:1.hebrew: וכללא הוא והרי כו' - תימה, דפריך אסיפא דמילתיה דכל שבחטאת רועה, וארישא נמי איכא למיפרך; דהא תמורת חטאת [או] שמתו בעליה דלמיתה אזלא, ואלו בפסח אמרי' במתני' דתמורת הפסח רועה אם המיר קודם חצות, דקבעיה חצות. וכן מתו בעליו — אמר לקמן דאי מת קודם חצות, דקבעיה חצות:
Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:4:1.english: "Is that a principle? Isn't [there]..." etc. - This is astonishing, that he raises an objection against the latter part of his [Shmuel's] statement — that whatever [in the case of] a sin-offering grazes [also grazes in the case of a Passover offering] — when against the first part as well one could raise an objection! For there is [the case of] a substitute of a sin-offering, [or a sin-offering] whose owners died, which goes to death; whereas regarding a Passover offering, we say in the Mishnah that the substitute of a Passover offering grazes if he substituted [it] before midday, when midday established it. And similarly, [regarding a Passover offering] whose owners died — he says later that if [the owner] died before midday, [it grazes] when midday established it.

Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:4:2.hebrew: רואין אותה כאילו היא בבית הקברות - נקט הכי משום דדחיית בית הקברות לאו דחיה היא, וכמו כן עברה שנתה לא חשיב דחוי כמו מתו או נתכפרו בעליה:
Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:4:2.english: It is viewed as though it were in a cemetery - He phrased it this way because the suspension [caused by] a cemetery is not [considered] a [permanent] rejection, and similarly, [a sin-offering] whose [first] year has passed is not considered rejected like [one whose] owners died or whose owners achieved atonement.

Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:4:3.hebrew: ורועה - פירש רש"י: "ויפלו דמיה לקיץ המזבח", ממדרשו של יהוידע. ואין נראה לריב"א, דלא נאמר מדרש יהוידע אלא בהפריש מעות לחטאתו או לאשמו ונשתייר מהם, או אבדו והפריש אחרים ואחר כך נמצאו, דמה שנשתייר יפלו לנדבה; אבל בכי האי גוונא שלא נתכפרו עדיין בעלים, אמרינן: תימכר ויביא אחרת בדמיה. והביא ר"י ראיה לדבריו, דתנן בפרק ולד חטאת (תמורה דף כא:): "ושאבדה — אם משכיפרו כו', ואם עד שלא כפרו בעליה — תרעה עד שתסתאב, ותמכר ויביא אחרת בדמיה". והשתא: בדחויה גמורה כמו אבדה, דמודי ריש לקיש לאחר כפרה דמתה, קתני "עד שלא כיפרו יביא בדמיה אחרת"; בעברה שנתה, דלאו דחוי גמור הוא — דאף לאחר שכיפרו בעליה אינה מתה — לא כל שכן שאם נסתאבה קודם כפרה דיביא אחרת בדמיה:
Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:4:3.english: And it grazes - Rashi explained: "And its proceeds fall to the supplemental offerings of the altar," [derived] from the exposition of Yehoyada. However, this does not seem [correct] to Riva, for the exposition of Yehoyada was stated only where one set aside money for his sin-offering or for his guilt-offering and [some] remained from it, or [they] were lost and he set aside others and afterward [the first ones] were found, in which case what remains falls to voluntary offerings; but in a case like this, where the owners have not yet achieved atonement, we say [that] it shall be sold and he shall bring another [sin-offering] with its proceeds. And Ri brought a proof for his words, as we learned in a Mishnah in the chapter [entitled] Velad Chatat (Temurah 21b): "And [a sin-offering] that was lost — if [it was found] after [the owners] achieved atonement, etc. [it is left to die]; and if before its owners achieved atonement, it grazes until it becomes blemished, and it is sold, and he brings another [sin-offering] with its proceeds." Now, regarding [a case of] complete rejection such as a lost [sin-offering], where Reish Lakish agrees that after atonement it is left to die, [the Mishnah] teaches [that] "before they achieved atonement, he brings another with its proceeds"; regarding [a sin-offering] whose year has passed, which is not a complete rejection — for even after its owners have achieved atonement it is not left to die — is it not all the more so [true] that if it became blemished before atonement, he brings another with its proceeds.

Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:9:1.hebrew: קודם חצות לאו אבוד הוא - פירוש: ובכי האי גוונא לא איירי שמואל, דהא שנינן: "כי קאמר שמואל, באבודין קאמר":
Tosafot on Pesachim 97a:9:1.english: Before midday it is not [considered] lost - Explanation: And in such a case Shmuel is not speaking, for we answered [above]: "When Shmuel stated [his ruling], he stated [it] regarding lost [offerings]."
